songs.title: Hot and Cold Clothes 🧣
songs.tune: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
lines: When it is cold, I wear a coat,
I wear a coat, I wear a coat.
When it is cold, he wears a scarf,
When it is hot, I wear my shorts,
I wear my shorts, I wear my shorts.
She wears sunglasses when it's hot,
n: 곡조: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'cold'에서 몸을 떨며 코트 입는 동작, 'hot'에서 부채질하고 선글라스 쓰는 동작을 화면 앞에서 함께 해요.
songs.imgPrompt: Children in two groups, one bundled in coats, scarves and mittens in the snow and the other in shorts, sunglasses and sandals on a sunny beach.

songs.title: Weatherman, Goodbye! 🌦️
lines: It is sunny, it is sunny,
But tonight it will be rainy,
I should bring my raincoat, too.
and it will be windy, too.
I must wear a warm, warm jacket.
n: 곡조: Oh My Darling, Clementine (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
학생이 손을 마이크처럼 들고 일기 예보관이 되어, 날씨 낱말마다 해·비·눈·바람 손동작을 보여 줘요.
songs.imgPrompt: A cheerful child weatherman pointing at a big weather map with sun, rain clouds and snowflakes while two kids watch holding a raincoat and a warm jacket.
